mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resident_mobility_log ( resident_id, change_type, change_date, from_region, to_region, reason, remark, operator_id ) VALUES ( #{residentId}, #{changeType}, #{changeDate}, #{fromRegion}, #{toRegion}, #{reason}, #{remark}, #{operatorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.resident_id, r.name AS resident_name, l.change_type, l.change_date, l.from_region, l.to_region, l.reason, l.remark, l.operator_id, u.username AS operator_username, l.created_at FROM resident_mobility_log l LEFT JOIN resident r ON r.id = l.resident_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operator_id WHERE l.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT l.id, l.resident_id, r.name AS resident_name, l.change_type, l.change_date, l.from_region, l.to_region, l.reason, l.remark, l.operator_id, u.username AS operator_username, l.created_at FROM resident_mobility_log l LEFT JOIN resident r ON r.id = l.resident_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operator_id WHERE l.resident_id = #{residentId} ORDER BY l.change_date DESC, l.id DESC
